tagline: Genie traces in the unified trace table (Beta): Genie Code and Genie One turns can now be exported to the Unity Gateway unified trace table as OpenTelemetry spans.
what_it_does: Genie traces in the unified trace table (Beta): Genie Code and Genie One turns can now be exported to the Unity Gateway unified trace table as OpenTelemetry spans. A workspace admin turns on tracing for each product from the Previews page. By default, only the trace table's owner can query the traces.
why_it_matters: Faster responses: Genie One now responds more quickly when you ask a question.
